## Step 7: Approval/Rejection Decision  
### Approval Criteria  
**Account Approved If:**
- ✅ KYC verification complete and successful
- ✅ Address verification complete
- ✅ AML screening passed (no sanctions hits)
- ✅ Risk assessment acceptable
- ✅ No regulatory concerns
- ✅ Account opening form complete and accurate  
**Approval Authority:**
- **Low-Medium Risk:** Account Manager approval
- **High Risk:** Compliance Head approval
- **Exceptions:** CRO approval (if policy exception)  
**Approval Time:**
- **Branch:** Immediate (1–2 hours)
- **Online:** Automated (<1 hour if no issues)
- **Postal:** 1–2 business days

raw_entities.description: The final approval or rejection gate for account opening, where compliance criteria are verified and an approval authority grants or denies account activation. The process includes risk-based routing to different approval authorities and defines approval timelines by channel.
context: Account Approved If: KYC verification complete and successful, Address verification complete, AML screening passed (no sanctions hits), Risk assessment acceptable, No regulatory concerns, Account opening form complete and accurate
Approval Authority: Low-Medium Risk: Account Manager approval, High Risk: Compliance Head approval, Exceptions: CRO approval (if policy exception)

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification Completion Check
raw_entities.description: Verification that KYC verification has been completed and was successful, as a mandatory approval criterion before account activation.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Completion Check
raw_entities.description: Verification that address verification has been completed as a mandatory approval criterion before account activation.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Results Review
raw_entities.description: Review of AML screening results to confirm no sanctions hits have been detected, as a mandatory approval criterion before account activation.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Evaluation
raw_entities.description: Evaluation of the customer's risk profile to determine whether the risk level is acceptable for account approval.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Concerns Check
raw_entities.description: Verification that no regulatory concerns exist that would prevent account approval.

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Form Accuracy Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification that the account opening form is complete and accurate as a mandatory approval criterion.
context: Account opening form complete and accurate

raw_entities.name: Approval Decision Recording
raw_entities.description: The formal approval or rejection decision made by the appropriate authority based on all approval criteria.
context: Approval Authority: Low-Medium Risk: Account Manager approval, High Risk: Compliance Head approval, Exceptions: CRO approval (if policy exception)

raw_entities.name: Account Manager
raw_entities.description: The approval authority responsible for approving account openings classified as low to medium risk.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The approval authority responsible for approving account openings classified as high risk.

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer
raw_entities.description: The approval authority responsible for approving account openings that require policy exceptions.

raw_entities.name: Risk Level Classification Gate
raw_entities.description: A branching decision that routes the approval to different authorities based on the customer's risk classification: low-medium risk to Account Manager, high risk to Compliance Head, or exceptions to CRO.
context: Approval Authority: Low-Medium Risk: Account Manager approval, High Risk: Compliance Head approval, Exceptions: CRO approval (if policy exception)

properties.purpose: Determine whether to approve or reject a new account opening based on KYC, address verification, AML screening, and risk assessment
properties.scope: All new account applications across all channels
properties.owner: Account Manager (low-medium risk); Compliance Head (high risk); CRO (exceptions)
properties.timeline_sla: Branch: 1–2 hours; Online: <1 hour; Postal: 1–2 business days
properties.trigger: Completion of all prerequisite verification steps (KYC, address, AML, risk assessment)
properties.outcome_failure: Account rejected or escalated for exception handling

properties.input: KYC verification records from customer file
properties.failure_path: Account approval blocked; escalate to Compliance Head

properties.input: Address verification evidence (utility bill, credit bureau confirmation)
properties.failure_path: Account approval blocked; request additional address proof

properties.input: AML screening results (sanctions list match status)
properties.output: Confirmation of AML clearance or identification of hits
properties.failure_path: If sanctions hit detected: escalate to Compliance Head; account approval blocked

properties.actor: Account Manager or Chief Risk Officer
properties.input: Risk assessment report (customer profile, transaction patterns, risk indicators)
properties.output: Risk classification (low, medium, high) and acceptability determination
properties.failure_path: If risk unacceptable: escalate to Chief Risk Officer for exception review

properties.input: Regulatory compliance checklist, customer profile, jurisdiction restrictions
properties.output: Confirmation of regulatory clearance or identification of concerns
properties.failure_path: If regulatory concerns identified: account approval blocked; escalate to CRO

properties.input: Completed account opening form, supporting documentation
properties.output: Confirmation of form completeness and accuracy
properties.failure_path: If form incomplete or inaccurate: return to customer for correction

properties.actor: Account Manager (low-medium risk); Compliance Head (high risk); CRO (exceptions)
properties.input: All verification checkpoints and risk assessment results
properties.output: Approval or rejection decision recorded in system; account opened or application closed
properties.failure_path: Decision not recorded: escalate to supervisor for manual intervention

properties.authority_level: Approval authority for low-medium risk accounts
Approval authority for high-risk accounts; regulatory concerns review
properties.approval_limit: High-risk account openings; regulatory exception review

properties.authority_level: Final approval authority for policy exceptions and unacceptable risk cases

properties.decision_question: What is the customer's risk classification (low, medium, or high)?
properties.criteria: Risk assessment evaluation results; customer profile; transaction patterns; jurisdiction; PEP status
properties.decision_maker: Account Manager or Chief Risk Officer
properties.path_yes: If low-medium risk: proceed to Account Manager approval
properties.path_no: If high risk: escalate to Compliance Head for approval review

properties.decision_question: Do all approval criteria pass (KYC, address, AML, risk, regulatory, form accuracy)?
properties.criteria: KYC verification complete; address verification complete; AML screening passed; risk assessment acceptable; no regulatory concerns; account opening form complete and accurate
properties.decision_maker: Account Manager (low-medium risk); Compliance Head (high risk); CRO (exceptions)
properties.path_yes: Account approved; account opened in system
properties.path_no: Account rejected or escalated for exception handling

properties.evidence_required: Customer identification document; proof of identity; KYC verification records
properties.failure_consequence: Account approval blocked; application rejected or escalated

properties.evidence_required: Proof of address (utility bill, credit bureau confirmation, or equivalent)
properties.failure_consequence: Account approval blocked; request additional address proof

properties.evidence_required: AML screening results; sanctions list match status
properties.failure_consequence: If sanctions hit: escalate to Compliance Head; account approval blocked

properties.regulatory_basis: FCA COBS 2.1R; Senior Management Functions (SMF) requirements
properties.evidence_required: Risk assessment report; customer profile; transaction patterns; risk indicators
properties.performed_by: Account Manager or Chief Risk Officer
properties.failure_consequence: If risk unacceptable: escalate to CRO for exception review

properties.regulatory_basis: FCA COBS; MLR 2017; GDPR; jurisdiction-specific restrictions
properties.evidence_required: Regulatory compliance checklist; customer profile; jurisdiction restrictions
properties.failure_consequence: If regulatory concerns identified: account approval blocked; escalate to CRO
